SELECT t_sales_area.id, t_sales_area.`status`, t_sales_area.area_no AS areaNo, t_sales_area.area_name AS areaName, t_sales_area.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_sales_area.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_sales_area.trade_type AS tradeType, t_sales_area.remark, t_sales_area.org_no AS orgNo, t_sales_area.org_name AS orgName, t_sales_area.dept_no AS deptNo, t_sales_area.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_sales_area WHERE t_sales_area.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_sales_area.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.area_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.areaNo}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.area_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.areaName}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.product_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassNo}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.product_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassName}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.trade_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.tradeType}, '%')
AND t_sales_area.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.remark}, '%')
ORDER BY t_sales_area.gmt_modified DESC
